levels.surface: عبد الرحمن بن يزيد بن جابر

notes: «مولى، امرأته أم عثمان» names no man: kept as unnamed.
Abu Dawud's remark «رواه الوليد بن مسلم عن ابن جابر» names another transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, not a route.
The Prophet's words follow «سمعت رسول الله» and are not a link; the wording remarks are left out.
